Definition: from G1746; investment with clothing:--putting on.
BiblicalUsage: Peter says a wife's adorning should not be the putting on of apparel in 1 Peter 3:3 — the outward dress is not where her beauty is meant to live.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Peter is pointing wives, and all of us, to a beauty that does not come off at night — the hidden person of the heart.
